apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.quotaHint: Leave empty to use the service-wide default.
apiKeys.expiresAtHint: Required and must be in the future. The suggested default is one year.
apiKeys.rotateTooltip: Revoke current and generate a new key
apiKeys.rotateInfo: This will disable the current key and generate a new one with the same name and expiration. The new raw key will be shown only once.
apiKeys.stagedRotationHint: Keep the old and new credentials active together for a bounded deployment window.
apiKeys.immediateRotationHint: Disable the current credential as soon as the replacement is created.
apiKeys.stagedRotationInfo: Deploy and verify the new credential before the overlap deadline, then complete the rotation. Cancel before the deadline to restore the old credential.
apiKeys.overlapHint: The old credential stops authenticating at this deadline even if the rotation is not completed.
apiKeys.rotationReplayRecovered: The existing rotation was recovered, but its shown-once secret is no longer available.
apiKeys.rotationReplayNoSecret: This is an idempotent replay. The raw credential cannot be shown again. Cancel this pending rotation and start a new one if the secret was not stored.
apiKeys.stagedSecretWarning: Store and deploy this credential now. It is shown only once, and the retiring credential stops working at the deadline.
apiKeys.rotationAlreadyPending: Complete or cancel the pending rotation before starting another.
apiKeys.policyUpdateError: Failed to update API principal policy
apiKeys.normalHint: Can use the assigned RAG data-plane capabilities, but cannot manage API keys.
apiKeys.readOnlyHint: Can call read and search APIs; write operations are denied.
apiKeys.readWriteHint: Can call both RAG read and write APIs; API key management is still denied.
apiKeys.adminCapabilitiesHint: ADMIN principals always retain both RAG read and write capabilities.
apiKeys.allCollectionsHint: The key can access current and future collections.
apiKeys.selectedCollectionsHint: The key can only access the collections selected below.
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this API key? Any client still presenting it starts failing with 401 immediately, and the revocation cannot be undone.
